lines.trans: Do you really want to go to the big dinner?
The Fouquet's is full of people.
Everyone will monopolize you over there.
I will not have a single minute alone.
I want to spend the evening together.
We do whatever you wish.
You are my absolute priority, darling.
I want to take off this red dress.
It has been scratching since the beginning.
This fabric is a real nightmare.
You were splendid on the red carpet.
But it makes me suffer terribly.
So, we return directly to the hotel.
That is the best idea of the evening.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Je ne dors plus et je fais des cauchemars.
examples.trans: I no longer sleep and I have nightmares.

examples.text: Toute cette histoire ressemble à un cauchemar.
examples.trans: This whole affair resembles a nightmare.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu réalises ce que tu dis?
examples.trans: Do you realize what you are saying?

meanings.note: as a form of address: chéri (to a man), chérie (to a woman)

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Je suis seule depuis trois mois.
examples.trans: I've been on my own for three months.

meanings.en: for (a length of time, still going on)

examples.text: Pourquoi il ne m'appelle pas directement?
examples.trans: Why doesn't he call me directly?

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.

examples.text: Je peux enlever encore cinq ans!
